# Scholastic Teachables

> > Scholastic Teachables provides thousands of printable worksheets, lesson plans, and classroom activities aligned to Common Core standards for PreK-8 educators.

This comprehensive resource library from Scholastic offers educational materials across all subjects including language arts, math, social studies, and early learning. Teachers can access themed activities for holidays and celebrations, animal studies, historic documents like the U.S. Constitution and Declaration of Independence, and skill-building exercises for reading comprehension, vocabulary, writing, and more.

## Key Topics

- Common Core standards
- Printable worksheets
- Lesson plans
- Early learning activities
- Reading comprehension
- Vocabulary development
- Writing process
- Social studies
- Holiday activities
- Classroom management
- U.S. Constitution
- Declaration of Independence
- Educational printables
- Teaching resources
- Mini-books

## Grade Levels

- [4th Grade](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/grade/4th.html): 4th grade worksheets across math, reading & all subjects

## Language Arts & Literacy

- [Vocabulary](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/language-arts/vocabulary.html): 4,000+ vocabulary games, crosswords & word learning resources
- [Writing Process](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/writing/writing-process.html): Writing process worksheets covering editing, revision & grammar
- [Journal Writing](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/writing/journal-writing.html): Journal writing prompts, personal narratives & mini-books
- [Traits of Writing](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/writing/traits-of-writing.html): Scholastic Traits of Writing lessons & mentor text activities

## Mathematics

- [Geometry](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/math/geometry.html): Geometry worksheets covering shapes, spatial reasoning & measurement

## Social Studies & Civics

- [Historic Documents](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/social-studies/historic-documents.html): Declaration of Independence, Constitution & historic document worksheets
- [Women's History and Experience](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/social-studies/womens-history-and-experience.html): Women's history worksheets featuring Rosa Parks, Helen Keller & more
- [Constitution Day](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/holidays-and-celebrations/constitution-day.html): Constitution Day civics activities & U.S. History resources
- [Election Day](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/holidays-and-celebrations/election-day.html): Election Day activities & social studies worksheets

## Early Learning & Foundational Skills

- [Motor Skills](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/early-learning/motor-skills.html): Scholastic printables for fine motor skills & alphabet learning
- [Following Directions](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/following-directions.html): 1,000+ printables for following directions skill-building
- [Sequencing](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/sequencing.html): Sequencing worksheets & graphic organizers across subjects

## Holidays & Celebrations

- [Christmas](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/holidays-and-celebrations/christmas.html): Christmas worksheets, holiday activities & winter printables
- [Kwanzaa](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/holidays-and-celebrations/kwanzaa.html): Kwanzaa worksheets & African American heritage activities
- [May Day](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/holidays-and-celebrations/may-day.html): Spring-themed May Day crafts & math activities

## Teacher Resources

- [Classroom Management](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/subject/teacher-resources/classroom-management.html): Teacher forms, record keeping & classroom management resources

## Themed Activities: Animals

- [Bears](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/animals/bears.html): Bear-themed worksheets, math problems & early learning activities
- [Squirrels and Chipmunks](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/animals/squirrels-and-chipmunks.html): Squirrel & chipmunk activities for math, literacy & early learning
- [Foxes and Wolves](https://teachables.scholastic.com/teachables/theme/animals/foxes-and-wolves.html): Fox & wolf themed literacy, math & folk tale activities
